title: TRADE REQUEST Image editor/pixel artist needed to help a blind game dev.

posts.author: LupineDev
posts.body:
Engine: RPG Maker MZ.
Game Synopsis: I'm working on two projects at the moment. One is a realistic modern fantasy turn-based RPG telling the story of a wolf pack and their struggles against another pack who bolster their numbers with stray dogs. The other game is a medieval fantasy turn-based RPG inspired by various Spyro games, a young dragon who can control one of eight elements must journey across various fantasy lands, save mythical creatures, collect coins, and fight an oppressive kingdom all in an effort to save their parents.
Roles needed: A pixel artist who is very familiar with RPG Maker's tilesets, can perform minor edits, and recolor.
What I'm trading for your help: I have an English degree and can help with editing and creating dialogue and other text used in-game. I work specifically with fantasy material, but I can take a look at your text if your project isn't fantasy oriented.
I am a published writer and freelancer. I've written video game articles for GamerBolt, and have done a number of editing jobs.
My roles: Writing, mapping, eventing, and programming. Basically, anything not art related.
Now to explain the title of this thread, I am legally blind and only have use of one eye. The eye that I use sees very blurry and in a sort of a double vison. This makes certain tasks difficult for me. I will go into more detail if needed with whoever takes this offer.

posts.author: rhinosoup
posts.body: Hellooo! I’m an artist, and I’ve made my own game before. This project looks really interesting! I can help with those ofc, and if you need other art elements I’m also down for it. If you’d like to see more of my art, we can chat more on Discord or any other social media you prefer. I can work on multiple projects at the same time haha, since I also have my own game in development right now but this wouldn’t be too much.
